notes.title: The New Tool in Demo Update 🗒️🔎
notes.content: [p]Greetings, Recruits![/p][p]Demo update 1.4.3 is live and this one comes with a brand new tool for your investigations, some improvements and bug fixes based on your suggestions and feedback. Here’s the full intel:                        [/p][p] [/p][h3] [b]What’s New in Demo Update 1.4.3?[/b]🔎   [/h3][list][*][p][b]Notepad[/b] [/p][p]For typing and drawing notes, perfect for connecting the dots (or doodling cats, we won’t judge). [/p][p][/p][p]                                               [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504489/28ae2fbed09060d5ba40fc8fe195c8415d2319cd.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Cursor Visual Cue[/b][/p][p]The cursor now changes based on the type of interaction you can have.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Field Guide[/b][/p][p]New section in the game menu describes the different tools available.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]More hints for the Magnifying Glass[/b] [/p][p]You can now find secret notes and hints when using the magnifying glass. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p] Bug Fixes [/p][list][*][p]Fixed UI element getting stuck on screen.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed Ghost animation breaking.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed texture issues in the intro video.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed UI issues on super ultrawide screens.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That’s the latest briefing. Thank you for sending your suggestions and feedback!💜 Make sure to report any suspicious activity back to HQ via the survey.[/p][p][/p][p]  End of transmission.[/p]

notes.title: Demo 1.4 update
notes.content: [h3]Patch Notes for Demo Update 1.4[/h3][p][/p][p][b]New:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Magnifying glass feature that highlights areas you haven’t interacted with yet[/p][/*][*][p]UI update: new title screen and in-game menus[/p][/*][*][p]Right click now moves you back (previously only via spacebar/ button)[/p][/*][*][p]Alt or middle mouse click to reset position within a room or return to the outside view[/p][/*][*][p]Hovering over inventory items now displays their names[/p][/*][*][p]New alert when attempting to enter locked rooms from outside[/p][/*][*][p]Added extra visual cues for certain puzzles[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved compatibility for ultra-wide screens[/p][/*][*][p]Solved puzzles now show “Status: Complete” in the hint menu[/p][/*][*][p]Improved input/feedback for the rotary phone puzzle[/p][/*][*][p]Improved requirements for the mug puzzle[/p][/*][*][p]Easier to switch between rooms via the stairs[/p][/*][*][p]Increased clickable area for the vase[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed repeating text bubble issue[/p][/*][*][p]Figurines appearing in incorrect positions[/p][/*][*][p]Visual glitch caused by anti-aliasing[/p][/*][*][p]Room highlight disappearing during the tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Stubborn teacup now resets properly[/p][/*][*][p]Resolution no longer resets unexpectedly[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed several saving issues[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 🕵️‍♀️ Demo Update 1.4 is Live! Exciting news
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504489/47f575f4088a78c5ad88972898dbb6e9e59543b7.png"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, Recruits![/p][p] [/p][p]Demo Update 1.4 is officially live and with it comes a batch of fresh improvements, fixes, and a few new tricks up your sleeve.[/p][p] [/p][p]Big [b]thank you[/b] to everyone who played the demo and took the time to fill out the survey. Your feedback has been incredibly helpful not just in shaping the game, but also in hunting down bugs, which have been thoroughly interrogated and dealt with.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]What’s New in Demo Update 1.4?[/b]🔎[/h3][list][*][p]  [b]Magnifying Glass Functionality[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Missed something? The new magnifying glass tool highlights points of interest you haven’t interacted with yet.[/p][list][*][p] [b]Major Hint System Overhaul[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Hints now have a much cleaner look and clearer messaging! In addition you’ll know when: a puzzle is fully completed, and when you’re at a location where, currently, there are no unsolved puzzles.[/p][list][*][p][b] UI Redesign[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The main title screen and in-game menus got a makeover, spy approved, and easier to navigate.[/p][list][*][p] [b]Improved Movement Controls[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]You can now move back using \[ Right Click ] ( in addition to Spacebar/Button).[/p][p]Added a new feature: tap/double tap \[ Middle Mouse Button ] or \[ Alt Key ] to reset the view back to room/ zoom out to the outside.[/p][list][*][p][b]And More...[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Tons of smaller improvements, polish, and bug fixes are included in the update. Full patch notes are available in the update log.[/p][p] [/p][p]If you haven’t played the demo yet or want to try it again, now’s a great time to jump in! Make sure to report your findings via our secure feedback channel (also known as a survey).[/p][p]You can find the survey in the demo or right here: [/p][p][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1a9tqn5-rVF0mvn3p9KP5mTDhBB9_aZptGbkRZip4OQ8/viewform?edit_requested=true"]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1a9tqn5-rVF0mvn3p9KP5mTDhBB9_aZptGbkRZip4OQ8/viewform?edit_requested=true[/url][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h3][url="https://steamcommunity.com/ogg/3520570/announcements/detail/508455949840679295?snr=2___"]🚨[/url] [b]Extra top-secret information [/b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/ogg/3520570/announcements/detail/508455949840679295?snr=2___"]🚨[/url][/h3][p]We’re excited to announce that Agent of Veil is part of the upcoming D4G Showcase/Event![/p][p]An exclusive new trailer will premiere during the showcase,  don’t miss your chance to catch a glimpse of what’s ahead for the full game.[/p][p] [/p][p]End Transmission.[/p]

notes.title: Agent of Veil Demo Out Now 🚨
notes.content:
[h3]Classified Document[/h3]
Greetings, recruits!

The wait is over!
[b]Agent of Veil demo is now live on Steam![/b]

[b]Mission brief:[/b] Infiltrate the[spoiler]demo and report back via the[/spoiler]top-secret[spoiler]feedback survey linked within. (Don't worry, it's only mildly[/spoiler]bugged for [spoiler]surveillance.)[/spoiler]

[b]What to Expect[/b] 🔍
[list][*][spoiler]Take part in a bizarre recruitment process[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Solve puzzles with slightly too many buttons[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Navigate a suspiciously over designed building[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Unwrap a very special present only recruits of the demo get[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Answer bizarre interview questions you can't prepare for[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Deal with a mysterious assistant named Ghost who is... helpful-ish[/spoiler][/list]


[b]Classified Note:[/b][spoiler]If you encounter technical anomalies, wish to[/spoiler]submit intel[spoiler] or just want to make contact, visit our community or send[/spoiler]encrypted communications[spoiler]to support@hellionred.com.[/spoiler]

[previewyoutube=lDGCn-6QCt0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Operation Cerebral Incoming:[/b] Tomorrow, May 29th,[spoiler]the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase begins. Agent of Veil is officially[/spoiler]on the mission list. Expect new intel[spoiler]drops and puzzle briefings throughout the event.[/spoiler]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504489/908f40380e77fe78a1c0d6c94f03501aef953327.png[/img]

End Transmission.
